tasks.short: Remove and replace tank-car dome caps

steps.what: Read the actual tank-car work instructions and confirm the permitted cap-handling conditions
Remove and replace the actual tank car dome caps using the required equipment
inputs: actual tank-car dome caps and tools
outputs: physically removed or replaced dome caps

steps.what: Direct assisting workers during dome-cap removal and replacement and check the physical result
inputs: actual assisting workers and cap condition

tasks.design: Keep actual cap handling and worker direction manual, with the existing {DOCS} instruction lookup separate. A native instruction view already serves the lookup; no recurring record write, send or automated cap-handling interface is established in this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cap handling depends on the actual equipment and permitted work conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional software change is established for this physical operation.
tasks.still_hard: Physical cap condition and coordination with assisting workers must be checked at the tank car.
tasks.human_edge: The loader observes the real condition and coordinates the handling.
tasks.altitude: Cap handling and the actual instruction check remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: tank-car cap handling requires physical equipment and on-site worker coordination.

assumptions: Shares are unmeasured hypotheses for handling with assisting workers.
Instructions and current work authorisation are inputs from the existing safety workflow, not generated or bypassed here.
No unused cap-completion log is invented; actual local permit or inspection record duties would need their own entry step and real time.
The instruction lookup is split and already uses its current native view.
research_questions: Does local practice require a separate actual cap inspection entry that changes this branch?

already_counted.description: All instruction reading, physical handling and coordination remain in s1 through s3.

incremental.description: No process change or additional upkeep is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. The actual instruction lookup is separated from physical work and direction. No further record, send or changed native operation is demonstrated, so all time stays retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform warehouse handling, inventory and material checks

steps.what: Check the actual warehouse order, item locations, units and inventory-count scope
outputs: checked warehouse work and item references

steps.what: Open actual containers and crates and physically fill the warehouse orders
inputs: checked warehouse work and item references
outputs: opened containers and physically filled warehouse orders

steps.what: Weigh and check the actual materials against item and quantity requirements
inputs: checked warehouse work and item references

steps.what: Physically count the actual inventory items within the assigned count scope
inputs: checked warehouse work and item references

steps.what: Enter the actual item, location, unit and quantity in the existing inventory tally
inputs: checked warehouse work and item references

steps.what: Transfer the tally's actual counts into the warehouse inventory record
Reconcile imported counts with the actual tally and resolve item or unit mismatches
Enter the actual order fulfilment, material weight and condition in the warehouse record
inputs: opened containers and physically filled warehouse orders
outputs: actual warehouse fulfilment and material-check entry

tasks.design: Configure a native {OPS_SYSTEM} work view and mapped import of the existing {SPREADSHEET} inventory tally to remove repeated navigation and actual second-system count entry. Retain physical opening, order filling, weighing, counting, original tally capture, mismatch repair and actual fulfilment entry; this does not automatically dispatch goods or approve stock adjustments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Inventory assistance can involve re-keying an existing tally into the warehouse count record.
tasks.enabler_now: A native count import can transfer compatible item-location-unit-quantity rows.
tasks.still_hard: Physical condition, true quantity and ambiguous item identity require the worker.
tasks.human_edge: The loader verifies the actual goods rather than trusting a stock figure.
tasks.altitude: Remove genuine repeated count entry while retaining warehouse handling.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: warehouse count imports can transfer an existing structured tally while physical counts and reconciliation remain manual.

assumptions: Shares are hypotheses for a mixed warehouse-support cycle with an existing spreadsheet count tally and manual second-system entry; other work mixes need reweighting.
The loader produces actual counts in s4 and captures item code, location, unit and quantity in s5; no free scan or coded discrepancy input is assumed.
Missing item codes or incompatible units stop for manual re-entry and repair in retained s7, reducing benefit.
The tally, count record and fulfilment record already support actual warehouse reconciliation; no unused trailing log is added.
An ordinary author save earns no saving; only real re-keying and specific navigation are removed.
Native configuration is tested first; existing automatic imports and shipment records yield no additional saving.
Import creates count observations only, not an approved stock adjustment or external shipment release.
research_questions: Is there a real second entry from the tally to the count record after existing warehouse capture is excluded?

already_counted.description: Original tally capture remains in s5; imported count reconciliation and manual mismatch fallback remain in s7.

incremental.description: Amortised item-location-unit mapping and work-view checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Work-view navigation removes 10*0.10=1 hour and real tally re-keying removes 10 hours, less 0.7 upkeep gives 10.3 net. Cautious case: many counted items have obsolete codes or incompatible units, leaving only 1.2 hours of import and 0.3 of navigation removed, or 0.8 net; manual repair consumes the rest of the nominal transfer benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain actual bulk-material and warehouse handling while eliminating only demonstrated record duplication.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish original capture from second entry
Keep count observations separate from stock adjustments
role.ambitious_version: A loader uses accurate warehouse records while personally checking the goods and performing the physical work.

job.title: Tank Car, Truck, and Ship Loaders
